svg.title: Shopping Copilot architecture
svg.desc: A React single-page app talks only to a NestJS server through the Vite dev proxy. POST /api/chat sends just the new user message; the server loads the conversation history from SQLite, runs the Vercel AI SDK agent loop against OpenAI gpt-6-luna with two tools, executes those tools against the DummyJSON API through CatalogService (per-keyword search, local ranking, price filtering, caching), streams the result back as typed UI-message parts that the browser renders as product cards, and persists the assistant message in SQLite when the stream finishes. A shared package holds the Zod schemas and types that form the contract between tool outputs and product widgets. Tests replace the LLM with a scripted model and DummyJSON with a fake; a separate eval runs the real model.
